profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield
profile.summary:
Highly motivated Software developer with over 7 years of hands-on experience in various tiers of application development. Demonstrated track record of handling systems analysis and design for complex web and desktop application projects. Proven knowledge of SDLC principles and standards. Committed to driving application and code quality through rigorous review, testing, troubleshooting, and debugging.

Languages:		JEE, Java, C++
Web:			JavaScript, Ajax, HTML5,CSS, EJB, JSP, Servlets, JSF, Angular , Vaadin
Web Services:		SOAP, REST
Databases:		MS-SQL, Oracle, Mongo DB
Tools:	Maven, Apache Tomcat, Glassfish, Docker, Eclipse, NetBeans, STS, MS-SQL Server, JIRA, Service mix, CA agile central.
Testing Tools:		Junit, Soap UI, Jmeter, Selenium
Frameworks:		Spring MVC, Hibernate/JPA, Bootstrap. 
Design Patterns:	MVC, Singleton, Factory, Façade, Strategy, Observer
Platforms:		Windows, Linux
SDLC:			Agile, Scrum, waterfall

positions.title: Application Developer II
positions.description: Principal Spring Boot - Vaadin developer for IRIS system, a web based application for monitoring observations and issuing storm reports. Also main contributor to Common Alerting Protocol disseminator application for real time alerting of non-weather hazards.

positions.title: Software Engineer - CenturyLink
positions.description: Back end developer for Ensemble Billing system, CenturyLink’s whole sale pre-order management platform that supports product offerings for several billing and provisioning systems for residential, Small and Medium Business, and multiple dwelling unit customers.

projects.title: Point of Sell Inventory Management System
projects.description: Programmed a web-based POS system for a PVC pipe company, allowing employee and product data tracking. Created with NetBeans, CSS Bootstrap Framework, Spring and Hibernate, Spring AOP, SQL.

projects.title: Course Switch & Placement Application
projects.description: Designed, developed, and integrated a web application enabling two students to switch university courses by preference. Created with NetBeans, JSF Framework, Bootstrap, JavaScript,Ajax.
